title: From sample diversity to interpretive convergence
abstract: Nature Reviews Psychology, Published online: 22 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s44159-026-00636-0 Generative artificial intelligence tools are being increasingly used by scientists, especially as writing aids for researchers outside English-dominant institutions. However, these tools might narrow interpretations even when applied to increasingly diverse samples. Sampling diversity will not be enough to broaden behavioural science if interpretive diversity is lost.
